definitions.explanation: A beach covered with sand, as opposed to a rocky or pebble beach. Refers to the physical sandy shore area.

examples.english: To walk on the sandy beach.

examples.japanese: {子供|こども}たちが{砂浜|すなはま}で{遊|あそ}んでいる。
examples.english: The children are playing on the sandy beach.

examples.japanese: {白|しろ}い{砂浜|すなはま}が{続|つづ}く{美|うつく}しい{海岸|かいがん}だった。
examples.english: It was a beautiful coastline with stretches of white sandy beach.

notes:
{砂浜|すなはま} refers to a sandy beach — a stretch of coastline covered with sand.

FORMS:
{砂|すな} (sand) + {浜|はま} (beach, shore).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {白|しろ}い{砂浜|すなはま}: white sandy beach
- {砂浜|すなはま}を{歩|ある}く: to walk on the beach
- {砂浜|すなはま}で{遊|あそ}ぶ: to play on the beach
- {砂浜|すなはま}が{広|ひろ}がる: a sandy beach stretches out
- {砂浜|すなはま}に{打|う}ち{上|あ}げられる: to wash up on the beach

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {砂浜|すなはま}: sandy beach (specifically sand-covered)
- {海岸|かいがん}: coast, seashore (general term, includes rocky coasts)
- {浜辺|はまべ}: beach, seashore (slightly literary)
- {浜|はま}: beach, shore (shorter form, also common in place names like {横浜|よこはま})
